summary.intent: Fix 2 failing CI E2E tests, unblock a stuck release-gate, and optimize the GitHub Actions CI workflow to gate cargo/Rust jobs behind Rust-specific path filters.
summary.outcome: E2E test fixes were committed and a PR created (FSM1/cipher-box#397). The CI workflow was updated to narrow the `desktop` filter to Rust-relevant paths only. The release-gate issue was identified as a stale workflow name reference that will self-heal once the PR merges.

repo: Playwright `test.beforeAll` has a hardcoded 30s default timeout that is independent of `test.setTimeout()`. All `beforeAll` hooks performing wallet login must explicitly set their own timeout.
The release-gate in the release-please PR was polling for `--workflow=e2e.yml`, which was renamed to `ci-e2e.yml` in PR #396. No code fix needed — it self-heals after rebase.
There is a `test-login` API endpoint that could bypass the wallet/Core Kit login flow, but no browser-side helper exists to use it in tests.
Wallet login is broken in the local dev environment (blank page, button not found) but works in CI — local environment is not reliable for E2E test development.
ci-e2e.yml has its own separate `desktop` path filter broader than the one in ci.yml, intentionally covering the full Tauri app including frontend for desktop E2E tests.
The `desktop` filter in ci.yml was narrowed to only Rust-relevant paths (e.g. src-tauri, Cargo.toml) so cargo check/test jobs don't run on TS-only changes.

code.finding: Added explicit beforeAll timeout and replaced Escape key dismissal of selection bar with `selectionBar.clickClear()` — Escape does not reliably dismiss the selection bar after a download action in CI.
beforeAll timeout was 30s default, too short for SW activation + wallet login. Added test.setTimeout(120_000) and explicit wait for SW controller before opening preview.
The `desktop` paths filter was narrowed to only Rust-relevant paths so cargo jobs are skipped on TS-only desktop changes. Cargo jobs already used the `desktop` filter condition.

workflow: When Playwright `beforeAll` times out it closes the browser context, causing misleading 'page closed' errors in the tests themselves — the root cause is the hook timeout, not the test logic.
Adding a retry loop inside a timed-out `beforeAll` makes things worse by consuming even more of the already-tight timeout budget.
CI path filters should be as narrow as the job actually requires — cargo jobs don't need to re-run for TypeScript or asset-only changes.
Renamed workflow files can silently break release-gates that reference the old name by polling indefinitely with no match.

friction: Local wallet login completely broken (blank page), making it impossible to verify E2E fixes locally — all validation had to be done by reading CI logs.
The first fix (login retry in beforeAll) made the root cause (beforeAll timeout) worse and had to be unwound.
`.gitignore` and `.husky/commit-msg` had pre-existing uncommitted modifications that had to be carefully excluded from staging.
Determining which tests used `beforeAll` required multiple grep attempts with slightly different patterns before finding all usages.
CI logs had to be fetched via gh CLI across multiple job IDs to piece together the full picture of what was failing.
open_items: A browser-side helper for the `test-login` API endpoint does not exist — creating one would allow E2E tests to bypass the flaky wallet/Core Kit login flow entirely.
All other `beforeAll` hooks across the test suite should be audited to ensure they have explicit timeouts set, not just the two files touched here.
Local wallet login flow is broken and needs investigation — currently the local environment cannot be used for E2E test development.
The release-please PR branch still has the stale `--workflow=e2e.yml` reference and will only self-heal after it rebases on main post-merge.
